title: explain_failure
description: Reads a stored diagnostic: cause category, offending view or example id, source span, JSON pointer, violated invariant, expected and actual, captured stderr slice, a concrete next action and a repeatable selector. Evidence, not a model diagnosis. Never runs a repair.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from a previous reply of the same query.

maxBytes.description: UTF-8 byte budget of the whole serialized reply (design section 4).
